name: kkce/kk-content-exporter
description: KK Content Exporter: exposes published WordPress content as configurable, read-only JSON feeds.

scripts-descriptions.lint: PHP syntax check (php -l) of every first-party PHP file
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at the level set in phpstan.neon.dist
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Unit tests (PHPUnit + Brain Monkey, no WordPress)
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Integration tests in the wp-env test environment (Docker; starts it when needed)
scripts-descriptions.test:all: Unit tests, then integration tests in Docker
scripts-descriptions.e2e: End-to-end tests with Playwright; starts the wp-env development environment when needed
scripts-descriptions.env:start: Start the wp-env development environment of the end-to-end tests (http://localhost:8890); composer run e2e starts it by itself
scripts-descriptions.env:stop: Stop the wp-env development environment (data kept)
scripts-descriptions.make-json: Write the JSON translations of the admin scripts from every languages/*.po
scripts-descriptions.i18n: make-pot, update-po, make-mo and make-json in order
scripts-descriptions.hooks:install: Activate the Git hooks of .githooks/ in this clone
scripts-descriptions.build:zip: Build build/kk-content-exporter-<version>.zip (clean tree, checks, .distignore, verification); options after --: --allow-dirty, --skip-checks
scripts-descriptions.svn:prepare: Prepare the WordPress.org SVN working copy from the build (dry run by default; --apply; never commits)
scripts-descriptions.check: lint, phpcs, phpstan and unit tests (the fast local gate)
scripts-descriptions.env:destroy: Delete the end-to-end environment: containers, database and volumes (no confirmation; the next start reinstalls WordPress)
scripts-descriptions.env:tests:start: Start the wp-env test environment of the integration suite (http://localhost:8891)
scripts-descriptions.env:tests:destroy: Delete the integration environment: containers, database and volumes (no confirmation)
scripts-descriptions.e2e:headed: End-to-end tests with a visible browser
scripts-descriptions.e2e:ui: End-to-end tests in the Playwright UI mode
scripts-descriptions.e2e:report: Open the HTML report of the last end-to-end run
scripts-descriptions.env:stop:all: Stop both Docker environments (end-to-end and integration), data kept
scripts-descriptions.env:destroy:all: Delete both Docker environments: containers, databases and volumes (no confirmation)
